# Manual Test Execution Report

This document captures how to retrieve and interpret the results generated by the manual Playwright test workflow.

## Workflow overview

The **Manual Test Execution** workflow (`.github/workflows/manual-test-run.yml`) restores dependencies, builds the solution, runs the Playwright/NUnit test suite and stores all outcome artifacts under the `TestResults` folder in the workflow run.

## Artifacts produced

* `TestResults.trx` — the TRX log generated by `dotnet test`.
* Additional Playwright trace files, screenshots or videos if they were generated during the run (saved alongside the TRX log).

All artifacts are uploaded automatically thanks to the "Upload test results" step configured with `if: always()`, ensuring they are available even when tests fail.

## Viewing the TRX log

1. Download the `test-results` artifact from the GitHub Actions run summary.
2. Open the `TestResults.trx` file with a compatible viewer:
   * Visual Studio Test Explorer (`Test` → `Windows` → `Test Results` → `Open Test Results`).
   * The free [trx-parser](https://github.com/isaacrlevin/TrxParser) web utility.
3. Review individual test case outcomes, durations and error messages.

## Sharing results

Attach the downloaded `TestResults` folder (or the rendered report exported from your viewer) when sending status updates so stakeholders can review the detailed evidence of the run.
